description_ru: Рита опаздывает на последний поезд и знакомится со странным попутчиком. Короткая ночная история.
text:
Rita ran along the platform, but the last train was already leaving. She was tired, wet and very angry. It was half past eleven, and her village was forty kilometres away.

An old man with a grey hat was sitting on a bench. "Don't worry," he said with a smile. "There is another train at midnight. It is a slow one, but it is warm." Rita was surprised. She looked at the timetable, and he was right.

They waited together and drank hot tea from his small bottle. The old man told her about his job. Thirty years ago, he was a train driver, and he drove through the mountains every night. "The best view in the world," he said.

The midnight train arrived, and Rita climbed in. Through the window, she watched the old man wave his hat. Next week, she was going to come back and bring him some cake.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро раскройте; зубы не касаются губы, не «в».
Кончик языка поднят и не касается нёба, губы чуть округлены; не раскатистое русское «р».

questions.question: Who did she meet?
questions.answer: An old man with a grey hat.

questions.question: What was the old man's job thirty years ago?
What is Rita going to bring next week?
